periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, angled approximately 45 degrees downward toward the rostrum relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Distinctly oval with vertical elongation, displaying a higher height-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering toward the snout, with the lowest point clearly extending below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape profile along the posterior margin of the interscapular band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick transverse band, covering the entire upper shoulder region and extending down to the forelimbs.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation, with a gap roughly equivalent to 1.5 times the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex semi-circular curvature at the superior margin of both ears.
